# Expanding Lottery’s Cultural Relevance - Without Alienating Longtime Players​


Mar 30, 2026


Article


With the way lottery is trending in 2026, growth comes from balancing new player engagement with long-term loyalty. At the 2026 EL/WLA Marketing Seminar, Brightstar Italy presented ways in how important the next generation of players can be in determining the future of our brands.
